Body.Content:
Custom Decision Service will soon be available in preview. This new service will help you create intelligent systems with a cloud-based contextual decision-making API that will adapt with experience. Custom Decision service will use reinforcement learning in a new approach for personalizing content—it’ll be able to plug into your application and make decisions in real time as it automatically adapts to optimize your metrics over time. 

Learn more about Custom Decision Service.
